Mexico.base: INEGI Encuesta Intercensal 2025 count (15 Oct 2025), UN 2025 age-sex structure rescaled to EIC shares 0-14 = 21.6 %, 65+ = 10.1 %
Mexico.tfr_source: INEGI EIC 2025, TGF for 2024 (survey direct estimate; registry-based figures run higher)
Mexico.net_migration: INEGI EIC 2025 net emigration: -230k/yr to 2030, tapering to -134k/yr by 2040 (midpoint of the 107-161k CPV 2020 range); EIC age-sex profile

Brazil.base: IBGE population estimate, 1 Jul 2025 (213.4 M), UN 2025 age-sex structure rescaled proportionally
Brazil.tfr_source: IBGE TFR 2023 (1.57) scaled by the 2024 fall in births (2,376,901 vs 2,523,267, -5.8 %, IBGE Registro Civil 2024), women 15-49 assumed flat
Brazil.net_migration: UN WPP 2024 net migration path (exception: no national estimate published; IBGE's 2024 revision identifies net emigration as its largest correction)

United States.base: US Census Bureau Vintage 2025, resident population by single year of age and sex, 1 Jul 2025 (341.8 M)
United States.tfr_source: CDC/NCHS final 2025 age-specific rates (Data Brief 571), summed: 5 x 315.2 / 1000

e0_anchor.source: CDC/NCHS, Mortality in the United States 2024

United States.net_migration: Census Bureau Vintage 2025: net international migration 321k in 2026 'if current trends continue', held constant
